te: Study visit and seminar in Ranong Province prepared
se: The meeting prepared a study visit to Ranong Province on 2–4 December 2024 and a seminar on managing foreign workers in the area, to hear information from agencies and others concerned in the border area
it: Study visit and seminar in Ranong Province (2–4 December 2024)

te: Agencies heard on digital labour services
se: The meeting heard the agencies concerned explain the Department of Employment's electronic services, the electronic work permit system and the Department of Skill Development's applications, for use in its study of using digital tools to help people find jobs and develop skills
it: Explanation of e-Services, the electronic work permit system and the skills development application

te: Questions prepared on digital platform workers
se: The meeting prepared questions for the agencies concerned, for use in studying the use of digital platforms to promote employment and the linking of labour data between agencies
it: Questions on using digital platforms to promote employment

te: 5 study topics chosen, and agencies to be invited
se: The meeting set 5 study topics: digital platform workers, employing older persons, workers in tourism and Thai massage, working abroad, and improving laws on migrant workers. It resolved to invite the Department of Employment, the Department of Skill Development, the Big Data Institute (Public Organization), the Digital Government Development Agency and the Office of the Vocational Education Commission to give information on 25 November 2024
it: 5 study topics
Agencies invited to give information (25 November 2024)

te: Scope of the subcommittee's duties set
se: The meeting considered the scope of the duties and powers of the Subcommittee on Employment Services and Skills Development, such as studying and analysing the employment situation, promoting employment and developing workers' skills, for submission to the committee
it: Scope of the subcommittee's duties and powers

te: Working group's plan set, and ways to raise the fund's income
se: The meeting noted the working group's plan for January–July 2025 and discussed ways to raise the income of the Social Security Fund, such as raising the wage ceiling used to calculate contributions above 15,000 baht and widening the investment framework
it: Working group's plan, January–July 2025
Ways to raise the income of the Social Security Fund

te: Stability of the Social Security Fund studied
se: The meeting considered its approach to studying the long-term stability of the Social Security Fund, including raising investment income, and resolved to set up a working group to study the fund's sustainability
it: Approach to studying the stability of the Social Security Fund
Setting up a working group to study the fund's sustainability

te: Meaning of "wages" in labour law studied
se: The meeting considered ways to give the word "wages" a consistent meaning in the Social Security Act, the Workmen's Compensation Act and the Labour Protection Act, to reduce differing understandings in calculating benefits
it: Giving "wages" a consistent meaning in 3 laws

te: Study direction for 2025 set, and a request for information considered
se: The meeting set the direction of its studies in fiscal year 2025 in 5 groups: older workers, migrant workers, Thai workers abroad, platform workers and young informal workers, and considered a petition asking for help in obtaining information from agencies, under rule 77, paragraph four, of the Senate Rules of Procedure
it: Study direction for fiscal year 2025 (5 groups of workers)
Petition asking for help in obtaining information from agencies

te: Understanding the overall picture of the social security system
se: The meeting discussed the context the social security system must deal with, namely demographic change, forms of work after the COVID-19 situation, new technology and the use of data. The social security system looks after more than 24 million insured persons
it: Context and challenges of the social security system

te: Study report on the draft labour protection law approved
se: The meeting approved the draft study report on the draft Labour Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. .... for submission to the committee, and agreed that the views of employers should be heard for its consideration
it: Draft report on the study of the draft Labour Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. ....

te: Background of the draft law on protecting informal workers heard
se: The meeting heard the Department of Labour Protection and Welfare explain the background of the draft law on protecting informal workers, which covers food and parcel delivery riders, together with the views of the Office of the Council of State on the legal status of these workers
it: Background of the draft law on protecting informal workers

se: The meeting heard the Department of Business Development and the Electronic Transactions Development Agency explain the rules on registration and notification of information for foreign e-commerce platforms serving Thailand
it: Rules on registering foreign e-commerce platforms

se: The meeting studied approaches to providing welfare for platform workers, such as food and parcel delivery riders, with proposals such as a fund to cover accidents and a minimum income
it: Approaches to welfare for platform workers

te: Framework for 2025 set, and maternity leave studied
se: The meeting set its working framework for fiscal year 2025 and studied maternity leave in the draft Labour Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. ...., comparing the right to maternity leave under current law with the standards of International Labour Organization (ILO) conventions
it: Working framework, fiscal year 2025
Maternity leave in the draft Labour Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. ....
